mapper.select: select bh.id, bh.user_id, bh.room_id, bh.browse_time, ri.room_number, ri.rent, ai.name apartment_name, ai.district_name, ai.city_name, ai.province_name from lease.browsing_history bh left join lease.room_info ri on bh.room_id = ri.id and ri.is_deleted = 0 left join lease.apartment_info ai on ai.id = ri.apartment_id and ai.is_deleted = 0 where bh.is_deleted = 0 and bh.user_id = #{userId} order by browse_time desc
select url, name from lease.graph_info where is_deleted = 0 and item_type = 2 and item_id = #{room_id}
